    // Returns the number of active incidents for a caller (sys_user sys_id)

        var count = 0;
        var ga = new GlideAggregate('incident');
        ga.addQuery('caller_id', userSysId);

        ga.addAggregate('COUNT');
        ga.query();

        }
        return count;
    },

<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?><record_update sys_domain="global" table="sys_script"><sys_script action="INSERT_OR_UPDATE"><abort_action>false</abort_action><access>package_private</access><action_delete>false</action_delete><action_insert>true</action_insert><action_query>false</action_query><action_update>false</action_update><active>true</active><add_message>false</add_message><advanced>true</advanced><change_fields>false</change_fields><client_callable>false</client_callable><collection>incident</collection><condition/><description/><execute_function>false</execute_function><filter_condition/><is_rest>false</is_rest><message/><name>Triage Router - Link CI and Route Hardwa</name><order>100</order><priority>100</priority><rest_method/><rest_method_text/><rest_service/><rest_service_text/><rest_variables/><role_conditions/><script><![CDATA[(function executeRule(current, previous /*null when async*/) {

    // Guard: nothing to link without a caller
    if (!current.caller_id) {
        return;
    }

    // ITSM/CMDB: link the caller's computer CI
    var ci = new GlideRecord('cmdb_ci_computer');
    ci.addQuery('assigned_to', current.caller_id);
    ci.setLimit(1);
    ci.query();
    if (ci.next()) {
        current.cmdb_ci = ci.getUniqueValue();
    }

    // ITSM routing: send hardware incidents to the Hardware group
    var isHardware = (current.category == 'hardware') ||
                     /laptop|computer|monitor|keyboard|printer/i.test(current.short_description + '');
    if (isHardware) {
        var grp = new GlideRecord('sys_user_group');
        grp.addQuery('name', 'Hardware');
        grp.setLimit(1);
        grp.query();
        if (grp.next()) {
            current.assignment_group = grp.getUniqueValue();
        }
    }

})(current, previous);]]></script><sys_class_name>sys_script</sys_class_name><sys_created_by>admin</sys_created_by><sys_created_on>2026-11-18 16:23:33</sys_created_on><sys_domain>global</sys_domain><sys_domain_path>/</sys_domain_path><sys_id>6f65e48783e013107755c810feaad38c</sys_id><sys_mod_count>0</sys_mod_count><sys_name>Triage Router - Link CI and Route Hardwa</sys_name><sys_overrides/><sys_package display_value="Triage Router" source="x_1910001_triage_0">153fd84b83a013107755c810feaad3f6</sys_package><sys_policy/><sys_scope display_value="Triage Router">153fd84b83a013107755c810feaad3f6</sys_scope><sys_update_name>sys_script_6f65e48783e013107755c810feaad38c</sys_update_name><sys_updated_by>admin</sys_updated_by><sys_updated_on>2026-11-18 16:23:33</sys_updated_on><template/><when>before</when></sys_script><sys_translated_text action="delete_multiple" query="documentkey=6f65e48783e013107755c810feaad38c"/></record_update>
